honesty_redline: Gazebo verifies high-fidelity dynamics such as hover stability, forward dash, and one-motor-out behavior. Datasheet endurance/mass closure remains Phase 8; do not treat Gazebo as endurance validation.

gazebo_design.source: Phase 8 realized components when available; DSE recommendation otherwise

gazebo_result.wind_fidelity: Gazebo closed-loop dynamics + lumped drag local linearization
gazebo_result.payload_release_fidelity: MAV_CMD_DO_GRIPPER to Gazebo detachable-joint physical separation
gazebo_result.parachute_fidelity: MAV_CMD_DO_PARACHUTE to Gazebo ParachutePlugin model creation/attachment

req_results.message: Gazebo one-motor-out hover did not remain stable

Gazebo closed-loop flight held 28.78 m/s ground speed in a 15.0 m/s injected headwind (minimum 2.0, opposition alignment=0.9999545502616829); WindEffects uses a lumped 0.05 m^2 drag-area local linearization

delivery-coordinate condition satisfied → physical detachable-joint separation delay=1.294 s (limit 2.0 s; command→separation 0.6764863749995129 s, detected=True); the coordinate condition was evaluated by the harness, not by generated mission logic

Harness triggered physical payload release at horizontal position error 0.7989850650481954 m (limit 1.0 m); this exercises trajectory/position/actuator coupling but not generated mission-logic ownership of the trigger

MAV_CMD_DO_PARACHUTE to Gazebo parachute model creation/attachment delay=0.040643791000547935 s (limit 0.5 s, observed=True); critical-failure detection and precedence were not injected by this subcheck

Gazebo nil-wind level dash held 20.97 m/s mean ground speed (peak 22.51 m/s; requirement >= 18.0 m/s); no wind injected during this segment, altitude held in ALT_HOLD, ground speed = airspeed in nil wind

Gazebo cruise attitude RMS 0.010 deg about the window mean (roll 0.005 / pitch 0.010 deg, n=74) during the nil-wind dash at ~19.1 m/s (limit 0.5 deg RMS); single speed point — 'all authorised speeds' not swept

Gazebo hover with 1.5 kg payload attached: attitude RMS 0.008 deg (limit 1.0 deg, n=313), hover throttle 37.94915254237288% -> margin 62.1% (required >= 30%); carry-hover window only — cruise-transport attitude not swept
obstacle/contact physics are Gazebo-tier; no implemented Gazebo check has produced evidence yet
req_results.requirement_text: REQ-FUNC-002: When approaching a stationary collision threat directly ahead within the forward sensor field of view at a closing speed no greater than 1.5 m/s, the system shall execute an avoidance manoeuvre following threat detection no later than 15 metres, maintaining an airframe-to-obstacle separation of at least 5 metres.
